name: Naomi
summary: A woman of Bethlehem who lost her husband and both sons in Moab and came home saying the LORD had brought her back empty. Through her daughter-in-law Ruth and Boaz, she was given a grandson, Obed, the grandfather of David.

key_moments.title: Loses Her Husband and Sons in Moab
key_moments.description: Naomi went to Moab with her husband Elimelech and their two sons because of a famine. Her husband died, and after about ten years both her sons died too.

key_moments.title: Comes Home Bitter to Bethlehem
key_moments.description: When Naomi came back to Bethlehem with Ruth, the whole city was stirred. She told them to call her Mara instead, because the Almighty had made her life very bitter.

key_moments.title: Sending Ruth to Boaz
key_moments.description: Naomi wanted to find a home for Ruth, so she told her to wash, dress, and go to Boaz at the threshing floor and lie down at his feet.

key_moments.title: Nurses Her Grandson Obed
key_moments.description: When Ruth bore a son, the women blessed the LORD for giving Naomi a near kinsman. Naomi held the child and nursed him, and he was named Obed, the father of Jesse, the father of David.
